evidence.activity: Tuition reimbursement and professional development courses for all employees
evidence.quote: Beyond compensation and benefits, we also value career development for all employees, and we offer a tuition reimbursement program, as well as professional development courses ranging from technical training, competency-based workshops and leadership development programs facilitated by external partners who are experts in their respective fields.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Management > Culture, Compensation and Benefits

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size (cap)

evidence.activity: Named two-year leadership program for managers (Exelixis Leadership Foundations)
evidence.quote: In 2024, we established the Exelixis Leadership Foundations, a comprehensive two-year leadership program designed exclusively to assist managers in achieving outcomes effectively.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Management > Culture, Compensation and Benefits

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size (cap)

evidence.activity: Inclusive family benefits including adoption, surrogacy, fertility and grandparent leave
evidence.quote: Our inclusive benefits are also designed to support family life with options including, among others, generous parental leave policies, grandparent leave, adoption, surrogacy and fertility programs
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Management > Culture, Compensation and Benefits

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: specific current internal practice (inclusive benefits), no reach figures

evidence.quote: We also work with third party consultants to conduct an annual, independent pay equity analysis to ensure our compensation programs are fair across our workforce.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Management > Culture, Compensation and Benefits

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: specific current internal practice, no reach figures

evidence.quote: We are proud to employ a diverse workforce that, as of December 31, 2025, was 57% non-white and 50% women.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Management > Our Workforce and Commitment to Inclusion

cross_cultural.criterion: level 1 at most: demographic statistics are a disclosure, not an activity

evidence.activity: Exelixis Access Services (EASE) patient support providing free drug to uninsured or underinsured patients
evidence.quote: Through EASE, we provide co-pay assistance to qualified, commercially insured patients to help minimize out-of-pocket costs and provide free drug to uninsured or underinsured patients who meet certain clinical and financial criteria.

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: named access service for underserved (uninsured/underinsured) customers, no reach figures

creativity.reason: Level 0: the business is oncology drug discovery and commercialization with no creative activity; drug licensing and use of advertising agencies are traps or marginal routine inputs, and when torn the lower level is chosen.

community.reason: Level 2: only employee development (tuition reimbursement, professional development, Exelixis Leadership Foundations) is described, so Community is capped at 2.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: specific current practices (inclusive family benefits, annual pay equity analysis, EASE free drug for uninsured or underinsured patients) with no reach figures, beyond the demographic disclosure.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: rests only on the company's own drug-discovery innovation; there is no enabling service for founders or small businesses, and the IRA 'small biotech exception' is a regulatory designation, not an enabling program.

ai.notes: The Item 7 (targeted) excerpt was empty, so scoring rests on Item 1 only. These items were excluded as traps: 'educate physicians' (marketing to customers), lab safety training (compliance training), CRADA, research collaborations and in-licensing (licensing or legal deals), and 'scientific community'. EASE was classed as customer access for underserved patients; it was not counted as Community investment because it is a commercial patient-support program with no figures. Discontinued programs (XL495, STELLAR-305 phase 3, XB064, XB033) are irrelevant to the themes. Workforce headcount fell 6.10% year over year.
